in Tier %(levels)s vehicles. Rise through the ranks to earn unique customization elements, vehicles, bonds, and other valuable rewards.

Each team can completely ban a vehicle from a battle. Coordinate votes with allies to exclude your most feared machine or to prepare an unexpected lineup for enemies. If your vehicle is banned, you can choose from several pre-configured rentals instead.

When the timer expires and no team has achieved a clear victory, the battle outcome is decided by tiebreakers in this order: surviving vehicles, damage dealt, and the first vehicle defeated. If no damage is dealt by either team, the battle is declared a draw.

Night Maps refresh familiar battlefields with nighttime conditions, new Observation Posts, updated POIs, and modified spotting mechanics. The current lineup includes Glacier, Sand River, Outpost, and Steppes.
The mode has modifiers that change certain parameters of the vehicle, such as vehicle hit points, consumables cooldown time, time remaining visible, and more.

Once you capture certain areas of the map, you'll gain access to Tactical Skills. There are two types of points of interest: Artillery Headquarters, which let you call in a targeted strike, and Comms Centers, which reveal all enemy vehicles. The number and location of these sites vary from map to map.

entries.msgstr: Progress through the ranks from Iron to Legend and earn valuable prizes. Fight throughout the Year of the Phoenix to receive unique Annual Rewards.

Depending on the role, each vehicle has a special skill with three charge levels. The higher the charge level when the skill is activated, the stronger the effect will be. The charge level will depend on the number of Prestige Points that can be earned for impressive performance in battle, capturing Points of Interest, using Tactical Skills, etc.

Check out the mode regulations to learn more about the different ways you can earn Prestige Points.

You can enter battle in Tier %(levels)s researchable vehicles (excluding SPGs), as well as Collectors' and some special vehicles. Prepare your vehicles in the Garage, then choose the best one based on the features of the given map once you get into battle. When selecting your vehicle, also consider which vehicles your allies have chosen.

Version 2.4 introduces new light tank roles and a rebalance of vehicle characteristics. Try them in battle!

Fresh gameplay on familiar maps. Changes include night conditions, new Observation Posts, new POI locations, and modified spotting mechanics. All of this reshapes the flow of battle, making awareness, timing, and tactical movement matter more than ever.

Due to low player population in battles, Super Platoons have been disabled. We are working on alternative team-based ways to play Onslaught. In the meantime, 7v7 tournaments are available on a regular basis.

• Maps: Erlenberg has been removed. POIs on Airfield have been repositioned. Minor tweaks to Pilsen.
• Vehicles: Vz. 60S Dravec has been removed. New German heavy tank Kampfpanzer 67 has been added.
